venue: The Magicians Room at the LINQ Promenade

zones.label: Section 1
zones.description: Section 1 is the closest section to the stage. It gives you the shortest distance to the performers in this compact showroom.

zones.label: Section 2
zones.description: Section 2 runs through the middle of the room. It keeps you close while giving you a little more perspective on the full presentation.

zones.label: Section 3
zones.description: Section 3 sits a step farther back. In this cozy showroom, it still keeps you close while giving you the widest view of the stage area.
